data.config.title: Global Settings
data.config.prompt: The settings will automatically save into 'config.json' when you shut down the program.
data.param.name: Name:
data.dialog.error.process_failed_desc:
If you see 'A numeric argument is out of range' or similar,
it may be that the Sizer output size exceeds the GPU's limit.
data.glslname.charset: Parameter name can only contain letters, digits, and underscores, and cannot start with a digit.
data.glslname.startwith: Parameter name cannot start with 'gl_' or 'ig'.
data.glslname.underline: Parameter name cannot contain double underscore '__'.
data.glslname.duplicate: Parameter name cannot be a {name} name or same as a parameter's you've already added.
